summary: AGI Inc filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that its subsidiary Agibank closed a second FIDC (Credit Rights Investment Fund) structuring, raising R$2.5 billion with a maximum 10-year term. The proceeds fund payroll-deductible loan originations. The fund issued a single tranche at CDI + 1.05% per year, with a AAA.br rating from Moody's. Agibank Asset Management co-managed the fund; Oliveira Trust handled administration. This is a routine debt-funding transaction, not a special situation.
